title: Rancho Camulos

services.name: Tea & Tours
services.desc: Each year, Rancho Camulos Museum hosts more than 1,500 school children to learn about what life was like living on a real California Rancho 170 years ago. Students visit the rancho’s main adobe home and make their own adobe brick. They learn about how the rancho was self-sustaining in terms of food and make a corn

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Discover the whimsical world of Carl Peters at the grand opening of our new Blacksmith Exhibition!Join us on Saturday, October 11th, from 1-4 PM as blacksmithing tradition comes alive at Rancho Camulos Museum. Carl Peters’ life and craft are forever entwined with the Rancho, keeping the fire of tradition burning for future generations. Rancho Camulos Museum is dedicated to preserving the historic adobe rancho and advancing the understanding of California’s early history through education, interpretation, and community
